items.html: And if we are more precise, it is found that the inner VAK of the Mochin of Yenika spread in the body in the two years of the Yenika; and afterward, the makifim [surrounding lights], the LM of the Tzelem of Yenika, enter together with the VAK of Gadlut. And the reason is compelling: for it is impossible for the makifim of Katnut to enter unless the VAK of the Mochin of Gadlut have already been made and formed, and they wish to enter; then they push the makifim of Yenika to enter first and become inner [lights], and after them they also enter.
